description: Guided reading of actual 2016 and 2018 Lean declarations: independent validity and maximum specifications, finite optimum existence, rooted matching recurrence, proof tactics and hypotheses, local dependency correctness versus a complete reference solver.

related_resources.reason: Independent nonempty weighted subtree isomorphism and rooted recurrence, including Eq. (1).
Independent mapped/skipped states and the reference-table correctness interfaces.
Lean 4 theorem syntax, quantifiers, inductive reasoning, typeclass assumptions and kernel proof checking.

learning_objectives: Read Lean theorem types as mathematical sentences with explicit input domains and hypotheses
Explain the independent 2016 Valid, IsMaximum and exists_maximum declarations
Follow both inequalities of rooted_matching_recurrence through decomposition and assembly
Separate local step correctness from reference table correctness, production refinement and runtime bounds
Recognize the roles of noncomputable definitions, typeclasses and common proof tactics
